name: dijitalpi
description: Small, single-purpose Claude Code plugins. Each one does one thing, ships as a single dependency-free file, and fails open.

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Warns before the context window fills up, while there is still room to save your work and start clean. Optional statusline badge and a /wrap-up command.

plugins.name: install-guard
plugins.description: Checks packages against their registry before installing. Blocks names that do not exist — the ones models invent and attackers register — and asks about packages that are brand new or barely downloaded.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks writes containing a live credential — AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, provider API keys. Leaves .env files alone.

plugins.name: scope-guard
plugins.description: Catches writes that land outside the project you are working in — the failure mode of having several repos open at once.

plugins.name: explain-simply
plugins.description: Appends a short, jargon-free summary to long answers, so non-experts can follow along. Always-on via hook, plus an on-demand /simply command.
